subject: Re: Invariant Slot Attention kickoff — unsupervised object inventories
body: Decisions from the post-mortem on the June runs. CLEVRTex sweep: landed, results strong — invariant reference frames keep ARI within 2 points of CLEVR performance on textured scenes, while the baseline drops 11. Waymo Open: we got a partial run only; preprocessing finished late (May 31) and the input pipeline underfed the accelerators for the first two days. Decision: Waymo scale validation moves to Q3 with the preprocessing done properly, and it goes into the OKRs before the June 26 lock. Productization: go for the object-inventory pilot on synthetic-plus-CLEVRTex evidence; the pilot partner's feed is closer to CLEVRTex statistics anyway. Chiara owns turning the conversion job into a maintained pipeline. Learning for the file: manual-download datasets get a two-week buffer, no exceptions. — Dmitri
